prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: complete rasterized presentation slide
Primary request: create one polished 16:9 Chinese presentation slide for the role "cover".
Communication purpose: 建立主题和核心判断
Single claim: AI 原生知识工作流
Audience: 产品团队、知识工作者与组织管理者
Art direction: international typographic style with rigorous grid and poster energy
Composition/framing: strict modular grid, hard alignment, oversized type, geometric crop, visible spatial logic
Color palette: warm white, true black, signal red, International Klein blue
Typography: bold grotesk Chinese sans serif with disciplined scale contrast
Imagery: high-contrast architectural or abstract photography treated as a geometric block. Page-specific visual brief: 城市、网络与知识流动形成的克制视觉意象
Material classification: image; use the matching visual representation and do not invent factual content.
Continuity anchor: swiss-grid-anchor; continuity group: swiss-grid-deck.
Materials/textures: flat ink, sharp edges, no shadows
Theme consistency anchors: signal-red top rule; blue offset block; grid-aligned page number
Text (verbatim, 文字必须逐字准确、顺序一致、每条只出现一次):
1. "AI 原生知识工作流"
2. "把散落信息变成持续可用的判断"
Constraints: render the complete slide as a single finished image; readable from a projector; strong hierarchy; generous whitespace; no editable UI; no watermark（无水印）; no logo.
Avoid: rounded corners; soft gradients; drop shadows; handwritten type; 不得添加任何其他文字; 乱码; 伪造数据; dense card grid; tiny labels.
